messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync - hardware-aware gating for new models. Need a concrete checklist to decide fast-track vs normal onboarding. Goal: final by EOD so we can answer Customer X.

aj (Eng): Proposed rule: score = 0.4*customer_demand + 0.3*perf_delta_norm + 0.2*hw_footprint_score + 0.1*deployment_risk. hw_footprint_score penalizes H100-only heavy models.

sam (ML): perf_delta_norm must be per-hardware: normalize to our internal baseline on same GPU family. Also include quality delta from eval suite, not just latency.

natalie (Solutions): If a paying Dedicated customer requests a model, add a priority boost (+0.25) but only if they accept pricing delta and SLA changes. Sales will need a comms template.

maria (PM): Draft launch gates: 1) perf targets met on declared hardware (p50/p95), 2) quality regression <= 2% on official eval suite, 3) capacity reserved for Dedicated requests, 4) rollout plan with canary (5%) and auto-fallback, 5) customer comms + pricing signoff.

aj (Eng): Implementation: catalog model entries get fields: preferred_hardware, min_gpu_family, bench_targets. Example YAML: ```preferred_hardware: H100
min_gpu_family: h100
bench_targets:
  p95_latency_ms: 120```

sam (ML): Bench harness plan: run p50/p95, throughput for typical batch mixes, and a 200-prompt quality set. Gate FP16 and 4-bit separately. If quantized variant meets quality & perf, allow it but keep explicit variant tags.

natalie (Solutions): Customer X timeline: wants cutover in 6 weeks. Can we commit? Need infra reservation and clear pinning policy.

maria (PM): Pinning proposal: pin by model+hardware pair (model@h100:version). Routing only falls back to another hardware if explicit compatibility flags and quality-preservation checks pass.

aj (Eng): Also build compatibility shim mapping (model@h100 -> model@h100-4bit) but only enable after bench validation. Fallback to lower-tier GPUs requires a quality safety net.

sam (ML): Important: quantify acceptable quality drift per customer type. For SLAs maybe <=1% drift; for self-serve <=3%. We'll encode in gating config.

natalie (Solutions): I'll draft the customer comms that explain hardware restrictions, pricing delta examples, and migration windows so support has a playbook.

deploy-bot: FYI: canary window reserved at 3920303055 for this model group; automated rollout will start if PRs and gates are green.

maria (PM): Next steps: aj - PR scoring + sample calculations; sam - prototype harness for h100/l4 including quant runs (5 business days); natalie - comms + pricing template. Thumbs? :thumbsup:

aj (Eng): 44d posting PR today with sample scoring calc.

sam (ML): 44d will start bench runs and include quant variants.

natalie (Solutions): 44d drafting comms & pricing, cc legal.

maria (PM): We'll reconvene after artifacts land. If urgent customer escalations come in ping me directly.
